posts.title: Scaling the Rocks: Kyle Freeland goes the distance
posts.description: DENVER, COLORADO - AUGUST 02: Kyle Freeland #21 of the Colorado Rockies looks on after his first career complete game win in a game against the Kansas City Royals at Coors Field on August 02, 2026 in Denver, Colorado. (Photo by Kyle Cooper/Colorado Rockies/Getty Images) Good morning, Purple Row! Here’s what’s going on with the Colorado Rockies and the rest of Major League Baseball. 2026 Rockies Individual Performance of the Year I thought there was a real possibility that Cole Carrigg would take home his third consecutive Purple Row Award, but Kyle Freeland earned a rather convincing victory with 52% of the vote for his complete game against the Kansas City Royals on August 2 . On one of the hottest afternoons in Coors Field history, with the trade deadline looming the following day, Freeland took the mound for his 251st career start. posts.title: Colorado Rockies Arizona Fall League Wrap-Up, 2026
posts.description: SCOTTSDALE, AZ - NOVEMBER 08: A general view of National League Fall Stars batting gear in the dugout prior to the 2026 Arizona Fall League Fall Stars game between the American League Fall Stars and the National League Fall Stars at Salt River Fields at Talking Stick on Sunday, November 8, 2026 in Scottsdale, Arizona. (Photo by Jill Weisleder/MLB Photos via Getty Images) | MLB Photos via Getty Images The Arizona Fall League officially completed its season on November 14th, when the Peoria Javelinas were victorious over the Surprise Saguaros. The Javelinas won the title for the first time since 2018, beating the Saguaros 8-3 on their home turf. posts.title: Willi Castro was a versatile and consistent bat in 2026
posts.description: DENVER, CO - AUGUST 17: Willi Castro #3 of the Colorado Rockies prepares to bat during the game between the Los Angeles Dodgers and the Colorado Rockies at Coors Field on Monday, August 17, 2026 in Denver, Colorado. (Photo by Ray Bahner/MLB Photos via Getty Images) | MLB Photos via Getty Images Welcome to the 2026 edition of Ranking the Rockies , where we take a look back at every player to log playing time for the Rockies in 2026. The purpose of this list is to provide a snapshot of the player in context. The “Ranking” is an organizing principle that’s drawn from Baseball Reference’s WAR (rWAR). It’s not something the staff debated. We’ll begin with the player with the lowest rWAR and end up with the player with the highest.
